title.value: Temporal Graph Benchmark for Machine Learning on Temporal Graphs
title.justification: The title of the paper is explicitly stated at the beginning of the provided text.
title.quote: Temporal Graph Benchmark for Machine Learning on Temporal Graphs

extractions.description: The paper introduces the Temporal Graph Benchmark (TGB), a set of large-scale datasets designed for evaluating machine learning models on temporal graphs across various domains, including social, trade, and transportation networks. It aims to standardize evaluation protocols and improve reproducibility in temporal graph research.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is the development and evaluation of machine learning models on temporal graphs, focusing on creating benchmark datasets and protocols. Climate or ecological sustainability is not a primary focus or application area; it does not directly address any climate or ecological issues or solutions.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We present the Temporal Graph Benchmark (TGB), a collection of challenging and diverse benchmark datasets for realistic, reproducible, and robust evaluation of machine learning models on temporal graphs.
